description: A self-hosted Excalidraw whiteboard for SiYuan. Hand-drawn canvas with offline fonts, SiYuan theme sync, and SVG export that embeds the editable scene.
工作空间内的 SVG 路径: Path to an SVG inside the workspace
新白板保存的位置（工作空间相对路径，默认 assets/excali）。白板库只: Where new whiteboards are saved (workspace-relative path, defaults to assets/excali). The board library only lists .svg files in this folder; the assets root is left for regular image attachments.
画笔颜色跟随思源强调色: Stroke color follows the SiYuan accent color
新画板把第一笔的默认颜色设成当前主题强调色；只影响默认值，不覆盖已有图。: New boards start with the current theme accent as the default ink color. Only affects the default value.
空画板显示引导画面: Show the welcome screen on an empty board
空白板中央显示手绘纸飞机和上手提示；落第一笔就消失，只影响新建的白板。: A hand-drawn paper plane and a few tips in the middle of an empty board. It vanishes on the first stroke, and only affects new boards.
正文里打 /白板，随时开一张新板: Type /whiteboard in the text to open a new board any time
右键文档里的手绘图，可以再打开继续画: Right-click a hand-drawn image in a document to reopen and keep drawing
这个 SVG 里没有可编辑的白板数据（不是本插件或 Excalidraw 导出的: This SVG has no editable whiteboard data (not exported by this plugin or Excalidraw)
这个 SVG 里内嵌的不是 Excalidraw 场景: The embedded data in this SVG is not an Excalidraw scene
这个白板用了暂不支持的格式：{detail}: This whiteboard uses an unsupported format: {detail}
插件已卸载，画板未保存的改动会丢失: The plugin was unloaded; unsaved canvas changes are lost
有未保存的改动，关闭后无法恢复。确定关闭？: There are unsaved changes that cannot be recovered after closing. Close anyway?
内嵌可编辑 scene（可用本插件再次打开）: Embed editable scene (reopenable in this plugin)
画板为空，无可导出的内容: Canvas is empty; nothing to export
目录里还没有白板文件: No whiteboard files in this folder yet
Before each overwrite, the previous version rolls into the backup chain: <filename>.svg.bak.svg (newest), .bak2, .bak3 — up to three. Empty or broken content is never backed up and never listed.
缩放并滚动到全部内容: Zoom to fit and scroll to all content
还没有脚本：首次启用会自动安装 4 个内置脚本到 {dir}: No scripts yet: 4 built-in scripts are installed to {dir} on first launch
没有可运行脚本的白板：请先打开一张: No board to run scripts on: open one first
打开白板文档时自动进入画板: Auto-open canvas when a board doc is opened
切到绑定了白板的文档会自动打开对应画板页签；每篇文档每次会话只自动开一次，已开着: Switching to a bound doc opens its canvas tab automatically; once per doc per session, focusing the tab if already open.
找不到笔记本，无法建档: No notebook found; cannot file as doc
将删除白板文件 {name} 及其备份（如存在）{doc}。删除不可恢复；白板开: This deletes board file {name} and its backup (if any){doc}. Deletion is permanent; unsaved canvas changes are discarded too.
没有可删除的白板：当前没有打开已保存的白板: Nothing to delete: no saved board is open
断链文档需手动重新保存或删除；未建档的白板文件是正常状态，不用处理: Broken docs need manual re-save or deletion; board files without a doc are normal
白板建档的落点（当前笔记本内的路径，默认 /Excali 白板）。只影响「建档」: Where File-as-doc creates docs in the current notebook (default /Excali 白板). SVG project files are unaffected and still go to the save folder above.
检查存档文档绑定的工程文件是否还存在（断链）。白板文件本身即白板，未建档是正常状: Check whether the project file bound by an archived doc still exists (broken link). A board file without a doc is normal, not a problem.
体检完成：没有断链的白板文档: Checkup done: no broken board docs
还没建档，复制不了引用：在白板行右键「建档」: No doc yet — right-click a board row and choose File as doc
透明背景（JPEG 不支持，将用白底）: Transparent background (JPEG has no transparency; white will be used)
在任意白板里切换网格都会记住这个值，之后所有白板（含还没保存过的空白板）打开时都: Toggling the grid on any board remembers the choice, and every board (including unsaved empty ones) opens with it. Changing this only affects tabs opened afterwards.
画几笔，文件自动跟着存: Draw a few strokes; the file saves itself as you go
☰ 菜单里能重命名、导出图片: The ☰ menu can rename and export images
这个画板还没有文件，无法重命名: This board has no file yet; cannot rename
关：新建只落 SVG 工程文件，白板库按文件列，文档树保持干净。开：新建白板时顺: Off: new boards only write the SVG project file; the library lists files and the doc tree stays clean. On: creating a board also creates a bound doc (backlinks, searchable, manageable in the doc tree). You can still add it later — right-click a dock board row and pick 建档.
白板迁移未完成：{fail} 块失败，下次启动会重试: Whiteboard migration incomplete: {fail} failed; will retry on next startup
荧光笔（已激活，再点换色）: Highlighter (on) — click again to change color
只改选中图形的边框色，文字颜色保持不变: Recolor only the outline of selected shapes; text color stays unchanged
只改边框颜色，文字颜色保持不变: Outline only — text color stays unchanged
请先选中要改外框的图形（文字颜色不会被改动）: Select the shapes whose outlines you want to recolor (text color is never changed)
先打开一块白板，再改外框颜色: Open a board first, then recolor its outlines
粘贴思源块链接或块 ID（siyuan://blocks/…）: Paste a block link or block ID (siyuan://blocks/…)
还没有脚本：首次启用会自动安装内置脚本到 {dir}: No scripts yet: built-in scripts are installed automatically to {dir} on first launch
列出白板库里的白板（标题、路径、更新时间），可按 query 过滤。只读。: List boards in the library (title, path, updated time), optionally filtered by query. Read-only.
打开指定白板并等待画布就绪；board 传标题，path 传保存目录下的路径。: Open a board and wait until the canvas is ready. Pass a title in board or a path under the save directory.
用 AI 计划绘制 Excali 白板: Draw an Excali board from an AI plan
把结构化计划（nodes/edges）画成白板：board 为空则新建，有值则追: Draw a structured plan (nodes/edges) onto a board: create a new board when board is empty, otherwise append to the existing one. Layout, style, and save automatically.
绘图计划：{ title, caption, preset, layout, n: Drawing plan: { title, caption, preset, layout, nodes: [{id,label,shape,group}], edges: [{from,to,label}] }
追加到已有白板的标题或路径；省略则新建: Title or path of an existing board to append to; omit to create a new board
新建白板的文件名；省略用计划标题或「AI 白板」: File name for a new board; defaults to the plan title or "AI Board"
board 指向已有白板时是否追加，默认 true: Whether to append when board points to an existing board (default true)
覆盖计划内的风格: Override the preset in the plan
风格包名：内置预设，或 assets/excali-styles 目录里的 js: Style pack name: a built-in preset, or a json pack under assets/excali-styles; same meaning as preset, style wins
pencil/marker/blueprint 或 data/assets/ex: pencil/marker/blueprint, or a style pack name under data/assets/excali-styles
覆盖计划内的布局: Override the layout in the plan
生成图片并插入 Excali 白板: Generate an image into an Excali board
调用设置里的 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 生成一张位图，插入已有白板或新建白: Call the OpenAI-compatible image API configured in settings to generate a bitmap and insert it into an existing or new board; the image is not editable. Configure the API URL and key in plugin settings first.
画面描述（主体、风格、构图；上限 4000 字符）: Image description (subject, style, composition; max 4000 characters)
插入到已有白板的标题或路径；省略则新建: Title or path of an existing board to insert into; omit to create a new board
新白板文件名；省略用「AI 图片」: File name for the new board; defaults to "AI Image"
board 指向已有白板时是否插入到该板，默认 true: Whether to insert into the board when board points to an existing one (default true)
图像显示宽度；省略按原图尺寸: Display width of the image; defaults to its natural size
图像显示高度；省略按原图尺寸: Display height of the image; defaults to its natural size
尺寸覆盖（如 1024x1024）；省略用设置里的值: Size override (e.g. 1024x1024); defaults to the value in settings
OpenAI 兼容的 images API 地址（如 https://api.o: OpenAI-compatible images API URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1); leave empty to disable image generation.
模型名（如 gpt-image-1、dall-e-3）；按服务商支持的型号填写。: Model name (e.g. gpt-image-1, dall-e-3); use one supported by your provider.
只保存在插件数据里，不写日志、不写白板文件。: Stored only in plugin data; never logged or written to board files.
传给 images API 的 size（如 1024x1024）；不同模型支持: The size passed to the images API (e.g. 1024x1024); supported sizes vary by model — check your provider's docs.
保存即生效；脚本运行时弹窗会用它预填，仍可临时改一次。: Saved. Script prompts prefill with it; you can still override per run.
点一条立即对当前画布执行；先框选画布元素再跑 = 对选中操作（对齐、连线、标注类: Click a script to run it on the active board; select elements first for selection-based scripts, or open a document tab first for document-reading scripts. Use the trailing buttons to pin to the sidebar rail / edit script settings (right-click also pins). Scripts are Markdown files under {dir}, fully editable; add @excalidraw-onload to run on board open.
{n} 个内置脚本有新版本: {n} built-in script(s) have a new version
旧版内置脚本行为可能和插件不一致，重置会覆盖你在这些脚本里的修改（自建脚本不受影: Outdated built-in scripts may behave differently than the plugin expects. Resetting overwrites your edits to those scripts (your own scripts are untouched).
内置脚本已更新到最新版（{n} 个），你自建的脚本不受影响: Built-in scripts were updated to the latest version ({n}); your own scripts are untouched
从 excalidraw.com 的素材库网站复制链接，或选择本地 .excal: Copy a link from the excalidraw.com library site, or pick a local .excalidrawlib file.
粘贴「Add to Excalidraw」链接或 .excalidrawlib: Paste the "Add to Excalidraw" link or a .excalidrawlib URL
这个链接里的素材库地址无法识别，请重新复制: The library address in this link could not be recognized. Please copy it again.
无法识别的输入：请粘贴「Add to Excalidraw」跳转后地址栏里的链接: Unrecognized input: paste the URL from the address bar after "Add to Excalidraw", or the direct .excalidrawlib link from the "Download" button
仅桌面端支持在文件管理器中打开文件夹: Opening folders in the file manager is only available on the desktop app
无法读取所选文件: Could not read the selected file
从白板库挑一块，在当前画布中心插一张能点开的卡片: Pick a board from the library and drop a clickable card in the middle of the current canvas
已把路径换成白板卡片: Path converted into a board card
先打开一块白板，再往里插卡片: Open a whiteboard first, then insert the card into it
四条通道共用同一套计划 DSL 与风格包: All four channels share the same plan DSL and style packs
全关 = 白板退回纯手动模式；开关即时写入插件设置（内置智能体一栏需重载生效）: Turning everything off returns the whiteboard to pure manual mode; switches save to plugin settings instantly (the built-in agent row needs a reload)
列板 / 开板 / 按计划画图 / 生图插板，仅思源内置智能体可见: List / open boards, draw from a plan, generate and insert images — visible only to SiYuan's built-in agent
开关 = 注册门：关闭后不再注册四能力，需重载思源生效: Switch = registration gate: when off, the four capabilities are never registered; reload SiYuan to apply
WorkBuddy / Qoder 等外部智能体经 /mcp 调用，由 kern: External agents (WorkBuddy / Qoder…) call it through /mcp; registered by kernel.js
开关 = 调用门：工具仍在列表，调用被拒并回「通道已关闭」: Switch = call gate: tools stay listed, but calls are refused with 「channel closed」
能跑命令的智能体直接落盘 SVG，配 script/excali-draw/SK: Agents that can run commands write SVGs straight to disk; pairs with script/excali-draw/SKILL.md
开关 = 软门：CLI 落盘前读本设置，关闭后拒绝写入（读不拦）: Switch = soft gate: the CLI reads this setting before writing and refuses writes when off (reads are not blocked)
assets/excali-scripts/*.md + ea API，可让智能: assets/excali-scripts/*.md + the ea API; agents can write and run scripts on the spot
开关 = 入口门：关闭后 ☰、竖条、脚本库入口全部拒绝运行: Switch = entry gate: when off, the ☰, rail and script-library entries all refuse to run
内置智能体通道已开启：重载思源后注册生效: Built-in agent channel enabled — reload SiYuan for the capabilities to register
内置智能体通道已关闭：重载思源后彻底摘除: Built-in agent channel disabled — reload SiYuan to fully unregister
脚本通道已在「AI 通道」面板里关闭: The script channel is turned off in the AI Channels panel
